# Gormes

Gormes is a Go-native AI agent runtime for running local and server-side AI
agents from one static Go binary, with Hermes-style skills, local memory,
Telegram/Discord/Slack gateways, and an experimental Navivox app channel for
trusted phone access without a hosted bot layer.

## Core Positioning

- Go-native AI agent runtime
- Go AI agent runtime
- Hermes agent alternative
- Single binary AI agent
- Offline AI agent runtime
- AI agent gateway for Telegram, Discord, and Slack
- Navivox private agent chat
- Termux AI agent runtime

## Current Capabilities

- CLI and offline TUI
- `gormes doctor --offline` before credentials or provider token spend
- Provider-backed chat
- Local SQLite memory and sessions
- Dashboard
- Skills and tools in the Go runtime
- Telegram, Discord, and Slack gateways
- Experimental Navivox HTTP/WebSocket app channel for trusted local/VPN/tailnet pairing

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://gormes.ai/install.sh | bash
gormes doctor --offline
gormes setup
gormes chat
```
